calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Step 1 of 2. The work calendar decides the working days and their events; the holiday calendar switches the day to the holiday mode.

mapping.title: Day mode
mapping.description: Step 2 of 2. Which mode each kind of day gets, and the calendar events that switch the day to a mode. Schedules, covers, climates and names are set later from **Configure**.

data_description.mode_absence: Picking this mode yourself pauses the automatic updates until you leave it. A calendar event switching to it pauses nothing.

keywords_section.name: Calendar events
keywords_section.description: An event whose title contains one of the keywords switches the day to that mode. Several keywords are separated by commas.

schedulers.title: Schedules
schedulers.description:
The schedules of the active mode are turned on, those of every other mode are turned off. Open a mode to edit its list.

A schedule acting on a climate must carry the name of its thermostat mode as a tag (scheduler-card, Options → Tags), or it runs whatever the thermostat mode. Without one: **{untagged}**
schedulers.submit: Save and back to the menu

covers.title: Heat protection
covers.description: Closes the covers marked 🌡️ in the cover list when it gets too hot: **{heat_covers}**. Protection only acts between the opening and closing times; once closed by the heat, a cover stays closed until the next normal opening or the evening close.

data_description.cover_temp_threshold: The covers close once the sensor goes above this temperature.
data_description.cover_weather_entity: Optional. When today's forecast high is above the forecast threshold, the covers close from the opening time on, without waiting for the sensor.
data_description.cover_forecast_threshold: Forecast high above which the early close triggers.

data_description.cover_my_button: When set, this button is pressed instead of the action below.
data_description.cover_action: “Close” sends close_cover. “Stop” sends stop_cover, which interrupts the current movement: useful for Somfy RTS covers.

daily_cover_schedule.title: Opening and closing times
daily_cover_schedule.description:
Applies to the covers marked 🕒 in the cover list.

**At {close_elevation}°, the covers will close at {close_at_elevation} tonight.**

**Tomorrow, a mode opening at sunrise opens at {open_at_sunrise}.**

close_section.name: Evening close
close_section.description: Once a day, for every mode, when the sun goes below this elevation.

data.close_when_window_shuts: Close as soon as the window is shut

data_description.daily_cover_close_elevation: 0° = sunset, -2° (recommended) ≈ ten minutes later, -4° ≈ twenty to twenty-five minutes later, -6° = end of civil twilight. A positive value closes before sunset.
data_description.close_when_window_shuts: A cover left up in the evening because its window was open closes (or goes to its My position) as soon as the window is shut, until the next morning's opening.

open_section.name: Morning opening
open_section.description: For each mode: at sunrise, no opening, or a fixed HH:MM time. Modes set the same way open together.

data_description.sunrise_earliest: At sunrise, the covers open no earlier than this time.

heat_pumps.title: Climate auto start/stop
heat_pumps.description:
For each climate (a Versatile Thermostat over_climate thermostat: heat pump, air conditioner...), HomeShift reads its target temperature and compares it to a threshold set for each thermostat mode. On the comfort side of the threshold it turns the auto start/stop off, so the climate keeps running; on the other side it turns it on: the scheduler's comfort and eco slots move the setpoint. It only acts in the thermostat modes that have a threshold, and only at a change (thermostat mode, setpoint crossing the threshold, start of Home Assistant): a switch flipped by hand stays so until the next change.

{heat_pumps}

menu_option_descriptions.heat_pump_add: Its auto start/stop switch and a setpoint threshold per thermostat mode
menu_option_descriptions.heat_pump_remove: Stop driving them, without touching the entities

heat_pump_add.title: Add a climate
heat_pump_add.description:
Pick the climate's auto start/stop switch and a setpoint threshold for each thermostat mode it is driven in. An empty mode is not driven.

While the climate keeps on the comfort side of the threshold, its auto start/stop is turned **off** and it runs. On the other side it is turned **on**: Versatile Thermostat may stop it.

data.threshold_heating: {tname_heating}: runs while the setpoint is at or above
data.threshold_cooling: {tname_cooling}: runs while the setpoint is at or below
data.threshold_ventilation: {tname_ventilation}: runs while the setpoint is at or below

data_description.switch: The Versatile Thermostat (over_climate) switch whose id ends with _enable_auto_start_stop. Any switch is accepted.
data_description.climate: The climate whose target temperature is read. Left empty, it is taken from the switch id (switch.salon_enable_auto_start_stop → climate.salon).
data_description.threshold_heating: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.
data_description.threshold_cooling: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.
data_description.threshold_ventilation: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.

heat_pump_add.submit: Save and back to the list

heat_pump_edit.title: Edit a climate
heat_pump_edit.description:
Climate: **{switch}** · current setpoint: **{setpoint}**.

An empty mode is not driven. While the climate keeps on the comfort side of the threshold, its auto start/stop is turned **off** and it runs. On the other side it is turned **on**: Versatile Thermostat may stop it.

data.threshold_heating: {tname_heating}: runs while the setpoint is at or above
data.threshold_cooling: {tname_cooling}: runs while the setpoint is at or below
data.threshold_ventilation: {tname_ventilation}: runs while the setpoint is at or below

data_description.climate: The climate whose target temperature is read. Left empty, it is taken from the switch id (switch.salon_enable_auto_start_stop → climate.salon).
data_description.threshold_heating: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.
data_description.threshold_cooling: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.
data_description.threshold_ventilation: In °C. Empty: not driven in this mode.

heat_pump_edit.submit: Save and back to the list

heat_pump_remove.title: Remove climates
heat_pump_remove.description: HomeShift stops driving the ticked switches; they keep their current state.
heat_pump_remove.submit: Remove and back to the list

error.invalid_calendar: The specified calendar entity does not exist
error.elevation_unreachable: The sun does not reach this elevation every day of the year at your location. Pick a value inside the sun's yearly range — 0° is sunset, negative values are below the horizon.
error.no_climate: No climate to read the setpoint from: pick one.
error.no_threshold: Set a threshold for at least one thermostat mode.
error.duplicate_keyword: A keyword is given for two modes: keep it in one.
error.no_cover_role: Tick at least one of “Open and close it every day” and “Protect it from heat”.
error.invalid_mode_name: A name is empty or contains a comma: commas separate the modes, so a name cannot hold one.
error.duplicate_mode_name: Two modes have the same name: give each one its own.

refresh_schedulers.name: Refresh schedules
refresh_schedulers.description: Refresh the schedules based on current day mode and thermostat mode

sync_calendar.name: Sync Calendar
sync_calendar.description: Re-sync the calendar and update the current day mode

open_covers.name: Open covers
open_covers.description: Open the covers of the daily schedule now, whatever the time or the day mode.

close_covers.name: Close covers
close_covers.description: Close the covers of the daily schedule now, like the evening close: a cover behind an open window stays up, a cover with a My button goes to its My position.

inhibit_covers.name: Inhibit covers
inhibit_covers.description: Temporarily take covers out of the automation (daily open/close, heat protection and the open/close-now actions). With neither a duration nor an end date, they stay inhibited until resumed.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers to leave alone. Only the covers HomeShift drives are accepted.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the covers stay inhibited.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the inhibition ends (instead of a duration).

resume_covers.name: Resume covers
resume_covers.description: Hand inhibited covers back to the automation. They rejoin the next scheduled action; nothing moves right away.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers to resume. Leave empty to resume every inhibited cover.

cover_not_managed.message: HomeShift does not drive {covers} — only the covers of the daily schedule and of heat protection can be inhibited.

inhibition_end_in_past.message: The end of the inhibition must be in the future.

not_loaded.message: HomeShift is not loaded: set it up, or wait for it to finish loading, then try again.
